\[
(f \ominus B)(p) = \min_{z \in B} f(p + z)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image
- \(B\): The structuring element

Each pixel becomes the smallest value under the element placed on it. Erosion takes the smallest value of f(p + z) for z in B. Dilation takes the largest value of f(p - z), which uses the element turned by 180 degrees. Both match the grayscale erosion and dilation of SciPy. On an image of 0 and 255 they are binary erosion and dilation.
